$comment: Single source of truth for type matchups. Edit here, not in the GDD or server.js. Each type beats exactly one type and loses to exactly one type. Cross-triangle matchups are always neutral (1x). Effectiveness multipliers: super effective 2x, neutral 1x, not very effective 0.5x.

triangles.name: Elemental
triangles.rationale: Water extinguishes Fire, Fire melts Ice, Ice freezes Water.

triangles.name: Storm
triangles.rationale: Earth grounds Lightning, Lightning charges and dominates Wind, Wind erodes Earth.

triangles.name: Mystical
triangles.rationale: Poison corrupts Light, Light banishes Shadow, Shadow smothers Poison.
